import owlready2
import time
import tempfile
import os
import threading

real_owl = ''file://C:/d/CursorProj/Chem-Ontology-Constructor/data/ontology/final.owl''
test_sqlite = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), ''chem_cached_final.sqlite3'')

print(''=== 实用方案：单World + RLock ==='')

# 初始化
print(''\n1. 初始化共享资源:'')
start = time.time()

# 创建共享World
shared_world = owlready2.World()

# 如果缓存存在就用缓存，否则从OWL加载
if os.path.exists(test_sqlite):
    print(''  使用SQLite缓存'')
    shared_world.set_backend(filename=test_sqlite, exclusive=False)
    shared_onto = shared_world.get_ontology(''http://www.test.org/chem_ontologies/chem_ontology.owl#'').load()
else:
    print(''  首次加载，创建缓存'')
    shared_world.set_backend(filename=test_sqlite, exclusive=False)
    shared_onto = shared_world.get_ontology(real_owl).load()
    shared_world.save()

init_time = time.time() - start
print(f''  初始化耗时: {init_time:.2f}秒'')

# 创建可重入锁
ontology_lock = threading.RLock()

# 模拟你的OntologyTools
class ThreadSafeOntologyTools:
    def __init__(self, world, onto, lock):
        self.world = world
        self.onto = onto
        self.lock = lock
    
    def get_class_info(self, class_name):
        with self.lock:
            # 模拟查询
            cls = self.onto.search_one(iri=f''*{class_name}'')
            return {''name'': class_name, ''found'': cls is not None}
    
    def get_properties(self):
        with self.lock:
            return list(self.onto.properties())[:5]

# 创建线程安全的工具
safe_tools = ThreadSafeOntologyTools(shared_world, shared_onto, ontology_lock)

# 10线程并发测试
print(''\n2. 模拟27个查询（10线程并发）:'')
query_count = 27
results = []

def execute_query(query_id):
    try:
        start = time.time()
        
        # 模拟查询
        result = safe_tools.get_class_info(f''class_{query_id}'')
        props = safe_tools.get_properties()
        
        elapsed = time.time() - start
        results.append({''id'': query_id, ''time'': elapsed, ''success'': True})
        
        if query_id % 5 == 0:
            print(f''  查询{query_id}: {elapsed:.3f}秒'')
            
    except Exception as e:
        results.append({''id'': query_id, ''success'': False, ''error'': str(e)})

# 使用线程池执行
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
start_queries = time.time()

with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=10) as executor:
    futures = [executor.submit(execute_query, i) for i in range(query_count)]
    for f in futures:
        f.result()

query_time = time.time() - start_queries

# 统计
success = sum(1 for r in results if r[''success''])
avg_time = sum(r.get(''time'', 0) for r in results) / len(results)

print(f''\n3. 性能总结:'')
print(f''  初始化: {init_time:.2f}秒'')
print(f''  27个查询: {query_time:.2f}秒'')
print(f''  总耗时: {init_time + query_time:.2f}秒'')
print(f''  成功率: {success}/{query_count}'')
print(f''\n  对比原方案（27×10秒）: ~270秒'')
print(f''  性能提升: ~{270/(init_time + query_time):.0f}倍'')
print(f''\n实施要点:'')
print(f''  1. QueryManager初始化时创建一个shared_world并加载本体'')
print(f''  2. 所有查询共享同一个OntologyTools实例'')
print(f''  3. OntologyTools内部使用RLock保护所有操作'')
print(f''  4. 无需修改OntologyTools API，只需内部加锁'')
